_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on pterodactyl/game-eggs' OpenArena egg (MIT).
name: OpenArena
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: The free deathmatch shooter built on the Quake III engine. Installs the ioquake3 server with OpenArena 0.8.8; add your settings to baseoa/server.cfg.
startup: exec ./ioq3ded +set com_basegame baseoa +set fs_basepath /home/container +set fs_homepath /home/container +set com_legacyprotocol 71 +set com_protocol 71 +set sv_master1 dpmaster.deathmask.net +set dedicated {{PUBLIC}} +set net_port {{SERVER_PORT}} +set sv_hostname "{{SERVER_NAME}}" +set sv_maxclients {{MAX_PLAYERS}} +set g_password "{{SERVER_PASSWORD}}" +set rconpassword "{{RCON_PASSWORD}}" +set g_gametype {{GAME_TYPE}} +exec server.cfg +map {{GAME_MAP}}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# OpenArena. Takes the server from Debian's packages for the node's CPU:
# the ioquake3 engine, OpenArena's game code built for it, and the 0.8.8
# game data (apt checks every package against Debian's signed archive).
# Your settings (baseoa/server.cfg) and added maps and mods are never touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server

fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
build=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
trap 'rm -rf "$build"' EXIT
rm -rf "$build"
mkdir -p "$build"

pkgs=(ioquake3-server openarena-server openarena-data openarena-085-data openarena-088-data
    openarena-081-maps openarena-081-misc openarena-081-players openarena-081-players-mature openarena-081-textures)
apt-get update -qq >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail "Debian's package archive can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
versions=$(apt-cache policy "${pkgs[@]}" | awk '/^[a-z0-9]/ { p = $1 } /Candidate:/ { printf "%s%s ", p, $2 }')
case "$versions" in *"(none)"*) fail "Debian's archive is missing an OpenArena package right now. Reinstall to try again later." ;; esac
version=$(apt-cache policy openarena-server | awk '/Candidate:/ { print $2 }')

if [ -x ioq3ded ] && [ "$(cat .raptor-openarena 2>/dev/null)" = "$(uname -m) $versions" ]; then
    echo "OpenArena $version is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading OpenArena $version (about 420 MB)"
    (cd "$build" && apt-get download -qq "${pkgs[@]}") || fail "The download failed. Reinstall to try again."
    for deb in "$build"/*.deb; do dpkg-deb -x "$deb" "$build/x"; done
    x="$build/x"
    [ -x "$x/usr/lib/ioquake3/ioq3ded" ] || fail "The packages didn't contain the server. Reinstall to try again."
    mkdir -p baseoa missionpack
    # Debian links the data into the server's folder; here they're copied.
    cp -f "$x"/usr/share/games/openarena/baseoa/*.pk3 baseoa/
    cp -f "$x"/usr/share/games/openarena/missionpack/*.pk3 missionpack/
    cp -f "$x"/usr/lib/openarena-server/baseoa/qagame*.so baseoa/
    cp -f "$x"/usr/lib/openarena-server/missionpack/qagame*.so missionpack/
    cp -f "$x/usr/lib/ioquake3/ioq3ded" ioq3ded.new
    mv -f ioq3ded.new ioq3ded
    chmod +x ioq3ded
    echo "$(uname -m) $versions" > .raptor-openarena
fi

if [ ! -f baseoa/server.cfg ]; then
    cat > baseoa/server.cfg <<'CFG'
// Your OpenArena settings, run at every start. The server's name, port,
// players, passwords, game type and first map are set from the Startup page.
seta fraglimit 20
seta timelimit 15
seta capturelimit 8
seta g_allowVote 1
seta bot_minplayers 0
CFG
fi
echo "Installed OpenArena $version."

variables.name: Map
variables.description: The map the server starts on, such as aggressor or oa_dm1.

variables.name: Game type
variables.description: 0 deathmatch, 1 duel, 3 team deathmatch, 4 capture the flag, 5 one-flag CTF, 6 overload, 7 harvester, 8 elimination, 9 CTF elimination, 10 last man standing, 11 double domination, 12 domination.

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name players see in the server list.

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: How many players can join at once.

variables.name: Public
variables.description: 2 lists the server in the master server list, 1 keeps it unlisted.

variables.name: Password
variables.description: The password players join with. Empty lets anyone join.

variables.name: Remote console password
variables.description: The password for rcon commands. Empty turns the remote console off.
